notes: Fixes GET /api/services/{id} wrongly 404ing for real, available catalog services that just aren't wired up to a Landing Category yet - it no longer requires a Landing Category match at all (that restriction, added in 1.31.7, was more than intended). Any currently-available synced service can now be looked up by id; "category"/"is_geo" in the response are still filled in when the service happens to match an active Landing Category (null otherwise), but that's no longer required for the lookup to succeed. GET /api/services (the category list endpoint) is unaffected. Requires 'Update database' for two new tables (catalog_services, landing_service_categories) if not already applied.
